storyline_causality_quote: A Meta executive admitted that starting the test without clearly telling users was a mistake.
entertainment_quote: It was as if someone took off an AI costume and a person stepped out.
comprehension_quote: There is a big difference between speaking because you think you are talking to a machine and speaking after you know a person is listening.
thinness_quote: When a human staff member handled a call, sensitive information from the user could be shared with a contract worker at a call center.
